notes.title: 🎉Celebrating One Year Since Launch with a Major Update!🎉
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/4fe14ea2253bd49603f6fee59bd7b82c37a9c185.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Celebrating One Year Since Launch with a Major Update![/h3][p]First of all, I want to thank the community for all the incredible support. This game was only completed thanks to you. For those who’ve been here since the beginning, you know how far it has come and how much time it took to fix and polish it.[/p][p]You might be wondering why some of these improvements—things that probably should’ve been there since day one—took almost a year. The truth is simple: I just wasn’t capable of doing them back then. I didn’t have the experience or the knowledge. It was never about not wanting to do things right. But now, after learning a lot and growing during the development of my new game, I’ve returned to this fan-favorite project to bring it up to the level of quality I aim for in my future titles.[/p][p]While there are still things that would require a full remake to truly fix (which isn't viable at the moment), I’ve put a huge amount of effort into this update. And without a doubt, you’ll notice the difference in your experience.[/p][hr][/hr][h3] What's New?[/h3][p]The most noticeable change is the introduction of [b]new key art and updated cover images[/b], along with many fixes and improvements to both gameplay and cutscene animations.[/p][p]But perhaps the most important addition is the [b]brand-new voice cast[/b]. As many of you know, the game originally used AI-generated voices for side characters. While I eventually replaced the main cast with real voice actors, those AI voices still dragged down the experience and often clashed with the performances of the real actors.[/p][p]Thanks to the support of an incredible team, every main and supporting character now has a real voice performed by talented professionals—bringing the game’s story and emotional moments to life like never before.[/p][h3]New Cast:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Sam[/b] – Roo Ryder[/p][/*][*][p][b]Claudia[/b] – Ché Grové[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rodrigo[/b] – Tavis Leeds[/p][/*][*][p][b]Casting Director[/b] – Steve Lloyd[/p][/*][/list][p]If you’re looking for amazing voice talent, I highly recommend reaching out to this team:
[/p][p][url="https://Bone13Productions@gmail.com"]Bone13Productions@gmail.com[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Full Patch Notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Brand-new voice acting for all remaining characters[/p][/*][*][p]Improved aiming angles and field of view[/p][/*][*][p]Combat is now smoother and more responsive: quicker transitions between melee, dodging, and aiming[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced combat encounters—less frustrating and more dynamic[/p][/*][*][p]Better audio feedback and impact effects for weapons[/p][/*][*][p]New locomotion animations for more natural movement[/p][/*][*][p]Updated models for supporting characters to match the quality of the protagonists[/p][/*][*][p]Improved interaction animations[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced cutscenes and facial expressions[/p][/*][*][p]Lighting and environment detail improvements in several scenes[/p][/*][*][p]General optimization and performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous gameplay and visual bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected visual glitches[/p][/*][*][p]Audio balancing for a more uniform volume experience[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you once again for all the support—none of this would’ve been possible without you. I hope this update brings new life to the game and gives you a fresh, polished experience worth revisiting. 🖤[/p]

notes.title: Chainsaw boss fight adjustments.
notes.notes:
One of the most important things I've learned as a developer is to listen to the audience and after hearing a lot of complaints about this fight feeling unfair and frustrating to most players, it has been adjusted to be more friendly and fair to all players. So thanks to everyone who shares their feedback so we can make a better game together.

-The execution will only occur when you are very low on health and the range of this execution is decreased considerably.
-The speed of this enemy is decreased a bit.
-The time between attacks is increased.
-There is now a margin of error that allows you to dodge this execution.

Tips to beat this enemy:
-Since there is an automatic execution when you are low on health, always remember to heal up when starting this fight.
-You can parry his attacks, just use the shoot button without aiming a bit before he attacks you.
-Don't forget to dodge, watch her attack animation carefully, it's slow and allows you to dodge right when she starts.
And don't forget:
Aim for the head!

PS: Remember that you can now add to your wishlist my upcoming game that will serve as a prequel to Selene's story:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310590/Lurking_Danger/

Game Overview:

Serving as a prequel to "Selene's Unberable Night" where you will learn more about this world and the dark secret that was hidden before Selene's arrival.

Step into the unsettling world of Lurking Danger, a survival horror game that will push you to the edge of sanity. You play as Elena, a young waitress at a seemingly ordinary diner, but her routine life takes a horrifying turn when she realizes she’s being watched by something—or someone—sinister. What starts as an ordinary workday quickly spirals into a nightmare, as Elena, with the help of her coworker Regina, discovers they’re being stalked by an unknown presence.

With strange customers and the sudden appearance of a mysterious, unknown place, Elena and Regina are drawn into a terrifying game of survival where reality and nightmares blur. Together, they must face the physical manifestations of their fears and unravel dark secrets as they fight to escape.

Key Features:
Immersive, Psychological Storytelling: Dive into a narrative that blends mystery and psychological horror. Every interaction and decision can reveal clues or escalate the tension.

Split-Screen Co-op: Play through the story solo or team up with a friend in local co-op mode. Work together to solve puzzles and survive the lurking dangers.

Interactive Environment: Use your surroundings to solve puzzles and uncover dark secrets in this eerie and disturbing world. The smallest, most unsettling details may hold the key to your escape.

Challenging Puzzles: Navigate strange corridors and twisted rooms, solving puzzles in a world where the walls seem alive, and grotesque creatures emerge from the shadows.

Intense Survival Horror: Face your worst fears as you run from unknown horrors. Manage your resources wisely and stay calm in high-pressure situations to stay alive.

Meaningful Choices: How you interact with secondary characters and face the dangers around you will shape your experience. Every conversation and action can influence the story's progression.

notes.title: VERSION 1.0 LAUNCHED!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/fb4d5ef4d6fd58ca3d9b696f35c423c62e2b32f7.png[/img]

After a long time and a lot of dedication, version 1.0 is finally here.
I never imagined that the game would have so much support, since the first version which was just a technical demo, the game was well received, which encouraged me to turn it into a full game and the support of many of you was always there. For which I appreciate all the support, without you none of this would have been possible. Thank you so much.
Like everything, this stage comes to an end, I take with me all the learning (which on this occasion has been a lot) and I am starting new projects, there are still many stories to tell and I hope to soon bring news and count on your support. Thank you once again.
The game will still receive support for bug reports and corrections if necessary.

Full list of this update:

-The final puzzle is improved, since it felt weak and uninspired, now its difficulty will be greater and you will have to pay more attention to the environment.

-Some lines of dialogue are improved.

-Some character and camera movements are improved.

-Adjusted some scenarios to be more consistent with events in the game's story.

-Optimization improvements.

-Bug fixes with saving.

-General bug fixes and adjustments.

notes.title: New voice actor for the antagonist and improvements for the final release.

notes.title: Hotfix

notes.title: The final chapters of the game and new voices with real actresses are added.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/3f6ed623c1ec55e3543b0524f1b47693178a73db.png[/img]

This update brings with it a lot of content. The most important thing being the addition of the final chapters where you will know the outcome of Selene's story. With this, some previous scenes and levels are modified and improved.
Another important aspect is the participation of two voice actresses, who will provide voices for Selene and Olivia, since one of the biggest complaints about the game was the use of voices with AI and how they do not transmit any emotion. This is solved with great performances that will give life to the characters. Delaney Gilmore as Selene and Holly Painter as Olivia.

And no less important are the addition of Steam achievements, now you will be able to obtain them by meeting certain requirements, so prepare your weapons and get to work, since it will not be an easy task to obtain them all.

In addition to these aspects, many changes and improvements are made. 
Complete list:

-New levels are added that close the game's story.
- Voice acting is added for the main characters.
-Steam achievements are added.
-Almost all the boss models have been changed, so that they have a better appearance and are more homogeneous with the game. With this, some combats are modified to add freneticism and others are adjusted to achieve fairer and less frustrating combats.
-Some scenes are modified to give the game a better appearance and add to the game's story.
-Combat is improved with better response times with weapons, sounds and visual effects are added to more clearly indicate the impact of hits and shots.
-A new outfit is added for Selene and with this the same outfits are added for Olivia, making them both use the selected outfit, of course, without leaving aside the personality of each one.
-Textures and lighting are improved in some scenarios.
-The volume of all sounds is regulated to have a more uniform sound quality without annoying volume increases.
-Many errors are solved, so many that I no longer remember all of them. D:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/11f6215563b676a65417b9623aa1d602f78c1e69.png[/img]

notes.title: New movement and adjustments.
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/16582715e6b6c02f682882750ce7a7a7d0579aae.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/16582715e6b6c02f682882750ce7a7a7d0579aae.gif[/img][/url]

A new movement is added to give more variety to combat and also prevent awkward situations where several enemies hit you at the same time.
This move is a kick that knocks out enemies for a few seconds. Now when you headshot small enemies, they will be stunned for a few seconds and if you decide to approach and interact, you will do this new move. This move will be completely optional, but will be useful to save bullets.


Fixed the error that caused the character to teleport when moving while crouching.

Improved impact reactions of basic enemies.

Fixed bug that caused blood to not stain some important surfaces.

Fixed the issue that caused the camera to not follow the character in some actions.

Other adjustments and fixes.

Yicheng Fan

FIxed errors with collisions in last level.

More enemies are added.
Fixed aiming issues that caused the character to not aim or sometimes do so even without the button pressed.

notes.title: New Chapter and major improvements.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/79e5f48e730a4ceec909a6a815586609a2c1b4e7.png[/img]

A completely new level is added, in this we will delve into the game's story, in addition to introducing new characters and enemies.
This adds a new completely unexplored area, which will be larger to encourage exploration.

-The position of the camera and its transitions are improved, this to have a cinematic camera that can follow the character's movements more accurately.
-Animations are improved and new character animations are added in some scenes.
-Major improvements in combat, the margin of error to make a counterattack is increased, in addition to dodging will give you a moment of invincibility to make it easier to perform these two actions.
-A new weapon is added: Uzi.
-Blood effects are improved, now they will stain some surfaces when falling on them.
-The accuracy of the shotgun is improved, since it was very easy to miss shots with it.
-Fixed the bug that caused shots to miss for no reason in some situations.
-New enemies and boss fights are added.
-Some lines of dialogue are improved.
-Fixed the character not falling when hit while climbing a ladder.
-Scenario adjustments.
-Improvements in movements.
-Bug fixes.

-Optimization is improved.

-Some lines of dialogue are improved.

-The AI ​​of human enemies is improved.

-Fixed the bug that caused the arrows to not display correctly on his back.

notes.title: Significant optimization improvements.

notes.title: New introductory level and character improvements.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/81fb9c3f0d34cce3985e9fc5f082c2ade90b426f.png[/img]

One of the biggest problems with the game's story was the beginning of it, since it was not clear and did not explain how our protagonists met each other. With this new update this is solved by adding a short level in a new scenario where you can understand better the beginning of this story. At the same time, the characters are improved with new clothing, more appropriate to the situation but without losing their previous identity, in addition to adding dynamic wrinkles that realistically act on the character's gesticulation and now the weapons that the character picks up will be shown on their back if you don't have it equipped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/6762acbba10c9837652bbeb2979d3ee0a79c52aa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44355886/06e58409fa59dc74370dc90dd78454a65dd23a02.png[/img]

Complete notes:

-A new introductory level is added that better explains the beginning of the story.

-The quality of the main characters is improved with new clothing, equipment and dynamic wrinkles.

-The camera movement is adjusted to have better tracking of the character and avoid awkward movements in combat.

-A default death animation is added, in addition to adding another situational one.

-Some scenarios are improved and modified.

-Some lines of dialogue are improved.

-Improvements in some cinematics and scenes.

-The character's dodge movement is improved.

-Improved impact reactions of basic enemies.

-Some combats are adjusted.

-Some textures are improved.

-Improvements in optimization.

-Sam's character model is changed.

-Bug fixes.

notes.title: Added option to change screen resolution.
notes.notes:
One of the problems with the optimization was that the highest resolution supported by your monitor was automatically selected, which, in some cases, demanded too much performance. Therefore, with this update, the option to change the resolution at will is added, so that you are able to decide which one is best suited to your PC.
Also some minor bugs are fixed.
